sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Hungarian often marks the possessor relationship directly on the possessed noun — either as a suffix attached to it, or as a stand-alone possessive pronoun built the same way.

items.english: All of my own things are here.

sections.content: Övék is just övé ('his/hers') plus a plural -k, so 'theirs' literally reads like 'his/hers, but plural of owners.' It's one of the few spots in this set where a visible plural marker gets added instead of building a completely new word.
